title: 🚀 Advanced GraphQL: DataLoader & Subscriptions
description: Standard GraphQL query resolvers suffer from the infamous N+1 Query Problem. If a client fetches a list of 100 posts along with their authors, a naive resolver fires 1 initial query for posts plus 100 individual database queries for each author (101 total DB roundtrips!).
